verification_trace: Each child verified ≥80% of its listings inside parent's broad area (per-parent radius 2-6km). Sunriver center hardcoded to 43.875,-121.450 (Matt-approved 2026-05-15). 'The Highlands at Broken Top' assigned to Broken Top via name-override (Matt-approved). 5 unassigned variants (River Forest Acres, North Rim, Skyline, Wildflower, Rock Ridge) are outside any resort community — they remain stand-alone subdivisions using SubdivisionName text equality. v2 patch (Matt 2026-05-15): Crosswater trimmed to 4 aliases (was 9). Vandevert Ranch promoted to own parent (single name). Three Rivers added as new parent (11 children). Kitty Hawk stays under Sunriver per closest-parent rule. 2026-06-27: 4 communities appended by hand from live MLS subdivision data — Mt Bachelor Village, Inn of the 7th Mountain, River's Edge, Mountain High. Method: exact MLS SubdivisionName match; center_lon_lat = centroid of that subdivision's listing coordinates (avg Latitude/Longitude over all listings, authoritative MLS data, 2026-06-27). | mls_cities added 2026-07-29: per-community MLS City spellings carrying active alias listings (audit sweep, Supabase listings); communities whose MLS City differs from the registry city were rendering 0 homes. | 2026-08-26 membership audit: the '>=80% inside-test' entries were re-verified one at a time against Deschutes County plat records + polygon containment. 21 false children removed (tetherow 7, northwest-crossing 7, broken-top 4, eagle-crest 3, brasada-ranch 1); sunriver, black-butte-ranch and widgi-creek confirmed unchanged. three-rivers keeps all 11 (the POLYGON is under-drawn, covering 51.9% of the 4,819-acre CDP). crosswater was settled by research at Matt's direction: Osprey Pointe Condo KEPT on its recorded declaration naming Crosswater Owners' Association as master association, Pace Estate and Lisle Acres removed (no HOA, no CC&Rs, across the river). Enforced from now on by scripts/check-resort-membership-evidence.mjs.

confirmed.name: Osprey Pointe Condo
confirmed.evidence: 0/9 inside the polygon, and KEPT on the strongest shape there is: its own recorded instrument. The Declaration of Osprey Pointe Condominiums (Deschutes County 97-33704, Book 462 Page 1137, recorded 1997-09-17) defines Master Association as CROSSWATER OWNERS' ASSOCIATION, INC. (S1.1.11), names the Crosswater CC&Rs (Book 346 Page 1105) as its Master Declaration (S1.1.14), submits the condominium to it (S12), and divides the Master Association Assessment into 24 equal parts, one per unit (Exhibit D). Its only frontage is Canoe Camp Drive -- a private road DIAL shows as owned by Crosswater Owners' Association and platted in Crosswater Phases 1 And 2 -- and the Crosswater Club's own address is 17600 Canoe Camp Dr, 0.3 mi away. It is a condominium carved OUT of Crosswater, which is exactly why it is absent from the union of the Crosswater Phase plats: the polygon test is what is wrong here, not the membership (CLAUDE.md S0 -- absence from one query shape is not absence).

corrected_2026_08_26.why: Neither is Crosswater, on county records and on their own listings. Pace Estates (CSNUM 08718, map 20-11-06) is a 4-lot subdivision on Spring River Rd; DIAL shows no association owning any parcel, MLS carries CCR's YN = No on 17340 and 17350, and the Deschutes County Title CC&R library holds zero Pace Estates documents against 10 for Crosswater and 13 for Osprey Pointe. Lisle Acres (CSNUM 08000, map 20-11-07-B) is a 6-lot subdivision on Lunar Dr adjoining the Deschutes River Recreation Homesites plat; the active listing for 56680 Lunar Dr states it is 'located just outside the resort area with no HOA & no CC & Rs', HOA dues $0, and Redfin files Lunar Dr under Three Rivers, not Crosswater. Both sit across the Deschutes from the gate -- 2.15 mi and 2.34 mi by road -- and 0 of their 32 geocoded listings fall inside the Crosswater polygon. Lisle Acres shares Section 7 with Crosswater Phases 1 & 2 and Osprey Pointe but on the opposite bank, which is most likely what seeded the original proximity match.
corrected_2026_08_26.supersedes: Matt's 2026-05-15 directive named Osprey Pointe Condo, Pace Estate and Lisle Acres as part of Crosswater. Matt asked for this to be researched rather than decided on geometry (2026-08-26). The research upheld the directive for Osprey Pointe -- and the recorded declaration proves it more strongly than the polygon could -- and overturned it for the other two.

verification.method: Subdivision_aliases = exact name-match core + obvious phase aliases confirmed <0.5km from centroid (live MLS, 2026-06-27). Nearby but separate subdivisions are intentionally EXCLUDED (a radius over-includes neighbors). Full boundary-based multi-subdivision assignment (closest-parent + >=80%-inside, like Tetherow) is deferred to the registry generation script for any of these that genuinely span more subdivisions (e.g. Mountain High golf area).

Deschutes County GIS plat containment (2026-08-26). Both aliases are recorded plats inside the Deschutes County Unincorporated Community polygon COMMUNITY=INN OF 7TH MOUNTAIN (stored as boundaries.geo_slug='widgi-creek'; that polygon covers this community, and community_subdivisions on it returns 'Seventh Mountain Golf Village' and 'Inn Of The Seventh Mountain (the) Phase IV'). No geo_slug='inn-of-the-7th-mountain' polygon exists, so the containment test runs against the polygon that does. Supersedes the prior '<0.5km from centroid' method.

Name-record + centroid clustering (2026-08-26). NO polygon exists for this community at any geo_type, and no Deschutes County plat is recorded under 'Rivers Edge', so the containment test has nothing to run against -- an absence about the query, not about the world (CLAUDE.md S0). Both aliases carry the community's OWN name plus a village/phase word, which is a phase claim on its face rather than the proximity inference that produced the Awbrey Glen defect (differently-named neighbours). Recorded as measured; upgrade this entry the day a Rivers Edge polygon is ingested.
